project: Project Sagar — 2D Fighting Game Animation Production

animations.name: Standing Guard
animations.gameplay_purpose: High standing blocking stance protecting head and upper body against mid/overhead strikes.
animations.transition_notes: Compatible with Batch 1 Idle Breathing; loops seamlessly F4 -> F1 while holding block input.
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Bottom-center ground pivot at (144, 272); both bare feet remain firmly braced on ground_y.

animations.name: Crouching Guard
animations.gameplay_purpose: Low crouching defensive block protecting against low kicks and sweeps.
animations.transition_notes: Matches Batch 1 Crouch Idle and Batch 2 crouching attack heights; loops seamlessly F4 -> F1.
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Bottom-center ground pivot at (144, 272); bare feet stay anchored low across all 4 frames.

animations.name: Light Hit Reaction
animations.gameplay_purpose: Short hitstun recoil from light jabs and pokes arriving from the right.
animations.transition_notes: Quick jolt (F1) -> light upper-body recoil (F2) -> recovers cleanly into Batch 1 Standing Guard (F3).
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Bottom-center ground pivot at (144, 272); feet stay grounded with minimal horizontal displacement.

animations.name: Heavy Hit Reaction
animations.gameplay_purpose: Deep hitstun stagger reaction from heavy attacks arriving from the right.
animations.transition_notes: Violent head/torso recoil (F1-F2) -> forward stumble (F3) -> regains footing (F4) -> weakened fighting stance (F5).
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Bottom-center ground pivot at (144, 272); front foot lifts briefly on F2 impact before planting on F3-F5.

animations.name: Launch / Knockback Reaction
animations.gameplay_purpose: Involuntary airborne knockback state when blasted upward/backward by launchers or heavy blowbacks.
animations.transition_notes: Impact lift-off (F1-F2) -> airborne backward tumble (F3-F4) -> back-first descent (F5) feeding directly into Knockdown F1.
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Airborne vertical offset preserved from strip baseline inside 288x288 cell; zero clipping on all 5 frames.

animations.name: Knockdown / Falling
animations.gameplay_purpose: Complete falling impact sequence culminating in a flat knocked-down ground state.
animations.transition_notes: Continues from Launch/Knockback F5 -> ground bounce impact (F5) -> flat lying-down pose (F6) matching Get-Up F1 1:1.
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Ground baseline at y=272; F1-F4 preserve airborne descent height, F5-F6 settle flat onto ground_y.

animations.name: Get-Up Animation
animations.gameplay_purpose: Wake-up recovery from knocked-down ground state back into active combat readiness.
animations.transition_notes: Starts in exact Knockdown F6 lying-flat pose (F1) -> push-up (F2) -> kneeling (F3) -> rising (F4) -> Batch 1 Standing Guard (F5).
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Bottom-center ground pivot at (144, 272); every frame stays firmly anchored on ground_y.

animations.name: Guard-Break / Stunned Reaction
animations.gameplay_purpose: Vulnerable guard-crush reaction ending in an open stunned posture for punish combos.
animations.transition_notes: Guard shattered wide open (F1-F2) -> backward stagger (F3) -> dazed slump (F4) -> stable holdable stunned posture (F5).
animations.pivot_consistency_notes: Bottom-center ground pivot at (144, 272); F5 designed to hold cleanly as engine stun state.
